name: Ember Hatchling
description: A palm-sized fire spirit that hatched from a dungeon cinder. Eager, clumsy, loyal.

name: Silt Crawler
description: A river-bottom scuttler with a shell like tempered iron. Slow to anger, slower to fall.

name: Gale Sprite
description: A sliver of living wind. Darts between hits faster than the eye can track.

name: Mossback Golem
description: Stone bones wrapped in centuries of forest growth. Moves like a landslide.

name: Voltfang Wolf
description: Its howl arcs with stormlight. Hunts in packs of one — itself is enough.

name: Tidecaller Kraken (Spawn)
description: A juvenile fragment of something vastly larger, still learning to pull tides.

name: Cinderwyrm
description: A lesser drake born of volcanic ash. Its scales glow brighter the angrier it gets.

name: Graveveil Wraith
description: A grudge given shape. Slips between the seams of a fight to strike where least expected.

name: Sunherald Phoenix
description: A herald-bird of the old dawn cults. Every fall from it is only ever a pause.

name: Voidmaw Behemoth
description: A tear in the world given weight and hunger. Dungeons fall quiet where it walks.

name: Eightfold Ashura
description: Bound centuries ago for adapting to any blow that touched it — it now adapts for you instead.

name: Worldroot Dragon
description: Older than the dungeons it now guards. Its roots run under every floor in Astral.

name: Tide Slimeling
description: A blue slime that has learned the shape of a cat. Throws itself in front of anything aimed at you.

name: Tide Sovereign
description: The slime, grown into its own silhouette. It no longer guards out of instinct — it chooses to.

name: The Sorter
description: A war-logistics jaeger left running its final standing order: ready the operator for battle. It reads every store you own at once, tucks your valuables where death cannot reach them, and racks your kit where your hand will fall. Equip it, then use .sort before a fight.
